header.title: ArUco Homography
header.subtitle: Rectify a phone photo and print it as a dimensionally accurate PDF at 1:1.

upload.title: Photo
upload.hint: For the best result: use the tele lens (1× or 2×), stand well back, keep the object centred. Wide angle bends the edges, and that distortion is not corrected.
upload.exif_focal: EXIF focal length {focal_mm} mm (35 mm equivalent) – the camera height can be determined automatically.
upload.exif_missing: No EXIF focal length found – enter the camera distance if you need a thickness correction.

params.title: Scale
params.marker_mm_hint: Edge length measured on the printout, black border included.
params.mode_hint: The marker sheet is more accurate, because its spacings are known.
params.spacing_x_hint: Distance between the two markers side by side.
params.spacing_y_hint: Distance between the two markers above one another.
params.thickness_hint: 0 if the sheet lies on the surface of the object.
params.camera_height_hint: Only needed when EXIF carries no focal length and the thickness is greater than 0.

crop.title: Crop
crop.hint: Grab the rectangle by a corner or an edge, or drag it to move it. The shaded area is the marker hull – anything well outside it is extrapolated and therefore uncertain.

export.title: Print
export.overlay_overview: Assembly plan as the first sheet
export.result: PDF created: {pages} page(s), page size {page_size} mm.
export.result_hint: When printing, be sure to choose {emphasis}, then measure the printed 100 mm scale to check.

adjust.title: Image adjustment
adjust.grayscale_hint: Drop the colour and show brightness only.
adjust.brightness_hint: Make the whole image lighter or darker.
adjust.contrast_hint: Widen the gap between light and dark.
adjust.saturation_hint: Make the colours stronger or paler.
adjust.local_contrast_hint: Brings out detail in evenly lit areas (CLAHE).
adjust.edge_boost_hint: Unsharp mask: makes edges clearer without moving them.
adjust.edge_overlay_hint: Draws the detected edges as lines on top of the image.
adjust.emphasis_hint: Bring one hue forward and hold the rest back.
adjust.emphasis_strength_hint: How strongly the chosen hue stands out.
adjust.threshold_hint: Reduce to black and white – gives a hard cutting edge.
adjust.reset_hint: All sliders back to their starting values.

android.title: On this device
android.subtitle: What the native core can do here — and what it cannot yet.
android.conformance_explain: The frozen scenes from shared/fixtures/ through the native core, measured against the ground truth — the same check that runs on Windows and in the browser.
android.detect_explain: Pick a photo and let the native core look for markers. This answers the one question no conformance run answers: does the core find the markers in a real picture from this camera?
android.sheet_explain: The A4 sheet everything starts from. It is built here on the device, from the same JavaScript as on the desktop and with the module bits of the native core.
android.full_explain: The same interface as on the desktop, unchanged — and the whole chain inside it: photo, markers, rectifying, template PDF. It computes in the native core and saves through the system dialog.

notices.camera_height_override: Using the camera distance you entered, {height_mm} mm (the EXIF estimate would have been {estimate_mm} mm).
notices.camera_pose_unknown: Camera height unknown (no EXIF focal length). Without an object thickness this has no consequences.
notices.camera_height_implausible: EXIF and homography give a camera height of {height_mm} mm – that is implausible, so it is discarded.
notices.single_marker: Only one marker detected: the homography is exactly determined, but without any redundancy – no error measure can be given.
notices.collinear_markers: The markers lie almost on a straight line. Across that line the homography has next to no support and becomes unreliable there; spread the markers over an area.
notices.high_residual: Residual error {rms_px} px ({rms_mm} mm) above the threshold. Likely causes: lens distortion, an unsharp photo, or a marker sheet that is not flat.
notices.marker_size_deviation: Marker {marker_id} measures {measured_mm} mm when projected back, instead of {expected_mm} mm ({deviation_pct} % deviation).
notices.marker_rotation: Marker {marker_id} is rotated by {rotation_deg} degrees against the anchor marker. Free mode assumes all markers share one orientation.

errors.upload_too_large: The photo is {size_mb} MB, and at most {limit_mb} MB are allowed.
errors.unreadable_image: The photo could not be read ({reason}). JPEG, PNG and HEIC are supported.
errors.bad_marker_size: Marker size and spacings must be greater than 0.
errors.sheet_too_small: A {marker_mm} mm marker with spacings of {spacing_x_mm} × {spacing_y_mm} mm does not fit on A4 ({sheet_w_mm} × {sheet_h_mm} mm).
errors.preview_missing: This preview has not been created yet.
errors.not_solved: Nothing has been rectified for this session yet. Please run “Rectify” first.
errors.session_expired: The session has expired. Please upload the photo again.
errors.margins_too_large: Margin and strip leave no usable area on {page_format}.
errors.overlap_too_large: An overlap of {overlap_mm} mm is too large for {page_format} ({usable_w_mm} × {usable_h_mm} mm are usable).
errors.camera_height_required: The camera distance is missing for the thickness correction: the photo carries no usable EXIF focal length (typical for forwarded images). Enter the camera-to-sheet distance in mm, or set the object thickness to 0.
errors.output_too_large: The result would be {width_px} × {height_px} pixels ({megapixels} megapixels), and at most {limit_mpx} megapixels are allowed. {hint}
errors.output_too_large_hint_crop: Not even {dpi} dpi is enough – make the crop smaller.
errors.no_markers: No ArUco marker was found. Check sharpness, lighting, and whether the whole marker sheet is in the frame.
errors.no_sheet_ids: Only the marker IDs {found} were detected. The supplied sheet uses {expected}. Switch to free mode, or print the app's marker sheet.
errors.homography_failed: No homography could be computed from the detected markers. Do they lie almost on a straight line?
errors.thickness_too_large: The object thickness ({thickness_mm} mm) must be smaller than the camera distance ({camera_height_mm} mm).
errors.android_bridge_failed: The bridge to the device did not answer: {reason}
